design.selectionBasis: Exact historical source-only review; all eligible old gaps plus the lexicographically first old complete control, without filtering on new candidate or answer success.

contextDefinitions.current: Exact independently reviewed additive v5 context
contextDefinitions.semantic: Independently reviewed full-twelve-case v6 replay context
contextDefinitions.reference: Independently source-reviewed sufficient reference preserving qualifications and unknowns

design.repeatsMeaning: Two repeated outputs per source-case/instruction/context cell, not independent product samples.
design.executionOrder: Repeat, old source-only case order, alternating instruction-contract order; existing adapter rotates context order by opaque case instance.
design.controls: Within a source case/repetition/context, both instruction contracts receive identical literal context and runtime policy; model route, settings, citation/schema interface and answer budget remain fixed.
design.anonymity: Opaque instance IDs use a private keyed derivation; keys, generation-contract mappings and operation identities are excluded from reviewer packets.

review.comparisons: Explicit anonymous source-aware reviewer verdicts; within-instance retrieval comparisons and separate across-instruction pairs at fixed source case/repetition/context. Keep each reviewer and disagreements; no algorithmic composite winner.
review.retention: Keep every planned arm, candidate miss, complete control, tie, disagreement, uncertain judgment, failed and unattempted answer. No replacement or resampling based on outcomes.
review.calibration: AI judgments remain provisional; source-checked human judgments exist only when actually saved and bound. Agreement is not ground truth.
